title: Coast Guard responds, investigates vessel fire in Fajardo, Puerto Rico
description: Vessel Emilia, a 75-foot motor yacht, is caught on fire in Fajardo, Puerto Rico with five people onboard, June 4, 2025.  All persons safely evacuated the vessel and were rescued by a Good Samaritan, while local firefighters successfully extinguished the fire. Coast Guard Sector San Juan marine investigators and Incident Management Division personnel are investigating and responding to the incident. (Courtesy Video)
